You were a scientist, now you are infected with an alien virus from an ancient meteorite that created this volcano. Blah bla                                                   Venture out into the island to raise power for your queen. Dont let the hired goons make it up to this lab, but if they do, you can use some of the power harvested for your queen to activate safety measures against the humans.                                                                                                                               Now go through the air vents and corrupt the invaders.
Dunes                   Foothills                   Forest                        Canopy                  Mushrooms                    Cavern                          Lab Entrance

How to play- In this infect map, humans must activate three radios and collect a rusty key from chests in order to open the radio tower which leads to the next level. Ammunition is limited, collect it from chests around the island. Hurry to the end- every time a zombie dies their power grows.                                                                                      Turn off particles and object animations for better performance.
